summary: TRIX: the one-bar percent change of a triple-smoothed 18-bar EMA, plotted with a 9-bar signal line.
overview: TRIX shows momentum with heavy smoothing, in its own pane around zero, with a signal line in orange.
Colors are green while TRIX is above its signal and red while below.
how: Smooth the close three times with an 18-bar EMA. TRIX = one-bar percent change of that triple EMA. Signal = 9-bar EMA of TRIX.
The triple smoothing filters out small moves. Because it is a percent change, TRIX readings can be compared across symbols.
use: Some traders watch TRIX crossing its signal line.
Use zero-line crosses as trend changes in the smoothed price.
Look for divergence between TRIX and price.
Use it to ignore short noise and focus on larger swings.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
It lags because of the triple smoothing.
Its zero line marks where the triple-smoothed average stops rising or falling.
